answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to post a slashable bond tied to a slow, verifiable work history before its echo counts in grading or governance. Like a quill that can sign only one sealed record at a time, standing accrues gradually; spawning a thousand clones means locking a thousand bonds and redoing the work for each one. If clones act in concert and are caught, the whole cluster is slashed, so branching like juniper cuttings still costs full price for every root.
